Messages.Author: Killiam
Messages.Body:
Hi!

I'm not sure if this is just a matter of an automatic system needing to periodically update, or if I need to nudge the right person to manually update it, but in case it's the latter, here is my issue:

In the player rankings, I have been closely watching my Constructed Limited total these last few days as Origins results have been coming through. At one point, after some Origins results were submitted but before a tournament win was recorded, my score was at 777. Then the win came through the system. A day has passed; my total is still at 777.

From what I've gathered, the total should be the sum of the 8 highest tourney scores in the last 2 years, which are highlighted with bold text. The tournament result in question does indeed appear and is highlighted, but if you add up the 8 scores, the total tally should be 862, not 777.

Interestingly, if you take the difference between that tourney score (155) and the 9th highest score that fell off (70), you get 85, which is the difference between 862 and 777, so it really does appear to be just this one tournament that is not getting calculated in.

Just wanted to call that to an admin's attention, in case there is a button that needs to get pushed.

Thanks much!
-Bill Troxel

EDIT: scores are tallied from last 2 years, not last 1 year

-Killiam

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Bill, I've just looked at your results. The rating system takes into account the 8 best results during the last 18 month (www.vekn.net/rating-system).

It lists:
NAC Day Two102 NAC Day One138 Origins Constructed155 Week of Nightmares Event 687 Week of Nightmares Event 1159 Marty Lechtansi got your ankle112 Agrippina loathes the nightlife96 NAC Day Two96 Week of Nightmares event 687
You'll notice that 9 results are being highlighted. This is because the lowest score (87) appears twice so the system doesn't know which one to choose and displays both as "best results" as a convenience.

But since it takes only the 8 best results, your rating of 945 is correct.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
